verdict.rationale: LightSprint documents plain-English requests as its main input. You describe a change, and agents build it, open a live preview and prepare it for review. Tasks can also be created from Slack, Linear or Jira. However, the evidence only shows natural language driving code-change and task creation, not operation of the product as a whole (board management, rollback, review/merge actions), and all evidence is vendor-claimed. Missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands control product operations beyond submitting change requests (e.g. rollback, merging, board/task management), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Describe the change in plain English. LightSprint builds it, spins up a live preview, and prepares for engineering review.
Ship polish fixes yourself - copy, spacing and colors
Create LightSprint tasks directly from Slack, Linear, or Jira. Updates sync both ways
Clear your bug backlog with background cloud agents
